answer: Challenge issue is rate limited to 11 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. An operator running 291 keys hence burns for 291 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the sable quota and the terrace admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the island ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
